summary.text: Liz Caruso is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 72, Somerset County, representing 32 towns and townships including Anson, Athens, Big Six Township.
The page lists committee service on Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Liz Caruso's education as Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (B.S., MBA, 1991, 1994).
The page lists Liz Caruso's occupation as Somerset County Broadband Director, SEDC and Town of Caratunk, First Selectman.
Listed affiliations include Registered Maine Whitewater Guide.
Liz Caruso lives in Caratunk and has served 1 session in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Judiciary (member); Leaves of Absence (member).
Family details on the page: married, spouse Greg, 2 children.
